en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a European town in a hilly river valley. In the foreground are multi‑story masonry houses and institutional‑looking buildings. A tall church with a baroque or neo‑baroque tower and spire dominates the right side. Near the center stands a very tall, slender chimney or obelisk‑like industrial stack rising above factory buildings along the river. In the background, wooded hills and patchwork agricultural fields stretch across the horizon. The overall style suggests an early‑20th‑century industrial townscape. No visible printed text or caption appears on the image.
